strongest_angle: Ethiopia has formally accused Eritrea of launching an all-out invasion into the northern Tigray region, prompting severe regional escalation and an urgent appeal to the United Nations Security Council.

key_facts.fact: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion in northern Tigray in a letter sent to the United Nations Security Council by Ethiopia's Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Eritrea urged the United Nations to take deterrent measures against Ethiopia, characterizing the confrontation as a declaration of war.
Eritrean soldiers crossed into northern Ethiopia towards Adigrat, where clashes have occurred between national army troops and regional forces according to local residents.
Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the Eritrean border as residents celebrated and the nation stated it was acting in self-defense.
